name: DIRECT_TEACHER_NO_SOURCE_RESIDUAL_V1
reason: Existing strong teacher controls are source-logit residual classifiers. A conventional direct teacher classifier must also be tested: structured gains might otherwise compensate a fixed shifted source prior. This is a principal baseline parameterization audit, not a new target model or an excuse to weaken KD.
task: Same human-accepted official boxes/IDs; target images/task queries/frozen teacher only; no manual targetGT in adaptation.
input: Exactly existing1080D full-query RGB/PCD, same initialization and channel moments. Source prior remains common image-only acquisition/tie-break information, but the direct classifier receives train/current z=0.
head: Same1080→64 GELU→1, same AdamW.001/wd.001, clipped teacher soft[.02,.98] and hard>=.5,4000min/16000max,teacherKL<=.005. Both train and prediction source-logit residual are exactly zero, not a lower prior weight.
factorial: GRAPH/CAL/JOINT use the very same direct soft mean head. Same fixed graph and PAVA as previous studies, no parameter/teacher/view/source updates.
primary: Compare current retained residual JOINT against all5 conventional direct teacher baselines; also test whether graph/calibration improvements survive on direct mean KD.
countmatched: JOINT vs KD_MEAN, both count directions plus both CountSelf:4percondition; scores from exact in-memory coarse expansion.
teacher_source: Same existing fresh source/QA collection as strictRGB/joint studies,1160C4/1103C1; prefix past/current only. No future teacher partition in learner normalization or training.
generation: All72outputs and quantities seal before this studyGT; same official HOTA/original-parent shared-seed descriptive statistics, no metric/seed/threshold changes.
GPU: Wait until all4 current physical cold workers have exited successfully and sealed. Then use free GPU0..3 only. No supplementary training perturbs current physical worker wall times.
statistics: Bootstrap fixed predictions, not refitted prefix pipelines; no correction for repeated development. Ordinary direct model includes a real teacher-supervised head, not point-label copy.
cost: Additional head fits are measured quality replay components, not new physical cold-time points. If this changes retained recipe/strong primary comparator, require corresponding physical follow-up.
acceptance: Do not finish original research goal solely on residual-KD victories if direct teacher controls remove them. Preserve all outcomes; no claim of guaranteed win.
